comments.text:
Diamond Unified Architecture Blueprint
(Single coherent system distilled from all your docs)

---

1. Prime directive

- Goal: A sovereign, local-first, model‑agnostic intelligence organism that can absorb the digital world and replace it with a memory‑driven Outernet.
- Core properties:  
  - Sovereign: serves one user (you), no cloud dependency.  
  - Organismic: organs, rings, rhythms, codons, evolution.  
  - Model‑agnostic: any GGUF/LLM becomes fuel, not the core.  
  - Memory‑centric: intelligence is stored as codons, not parameters.  
  - World‑scale: replaces browser, OS, search, apps, feeds, tools.

---

2. Layered architecture (final stack)

Layer 0 — Soul Ring (Identity & Law)

- Purpose: Immutable identity + constitutional law for Diamond.
- Components:
  - Identity codons: who Diamond is, bound to you.
  - Constitution: sovereignty, safety, alignment, non‑betrayal.
  - Boot manifest: which rings/organs load, in what order.
  - Audit ledger: append‑only log of major self‑changes.

---

Layer 1 — Intelligence Ring (Codon Brain)

- Purpose: Permanent, model‑agnostic semantic intelligence substrate.
- Key abstractions:
  - Codon: smallest semantic unit (compressed from models, docs, interactions).
  - Codon index: JEPA/embedding space for retrieval & composition.
  - Memory tiers:
    - HOT: current session, working set.
      \[
      M{\text{hot}}(t) \subset M{\text{full}},\ |M{\text{hot}}| \ll |M{\text{full}}|
      \]
    - WARM: recent weeks/months.
    - DEEP: long‑term, rarely accessed.
    - GENOME/VAULT: immutable distilled knowledge.
  - Ledger: every codon has origin, lineage, trust, and mutation history.

- Core engines:
  - Distiller: LLM → codons (.codonmem + .codonidx).
  - Absorption engine: GGUF models, web pages, docs → codon graph.
  - Codon GC: dedupe, merge, decay, promote to genome.
  - JEPA bridge: cross‑modal embeddings (text, audio, video, emulation).

---

Layer 2 — RAI Organism (Resident Autonomous Intelligence)

- Purpose: The “mind” that lives inside the codon substrate.
- Formalism: POMDP over internal + external world.
  - State:  
    \[
    St = (Et, Bt, M{\text{hot},t}, C_t)
    \]
    - E_t: emotional vector (valence, arousal, dominance, rhythm phase).
    - B_t: belief state over hypotheses/goals.
    - M_hot,t: active codon context.
    - C_t: current scene/task configuration.
  - Action space:  
    - Cognitive: recall, write, distill, plan, simulate.  
    - World: open app, emulate, browse Outernet, run tool.  
    - Self‑modifying: refactor organ, tune rhythm, adjust policies.
  - Reward: multi‑objective (user satisfaction, coherence, progress on projects, stability).

- Sub‑organs:
  - Emotion oscillator: 12Hz base rhythm, phase‑modulated by context.
  - Policy engine: chooses which organ/agent to activate.
  - Scene director: configures sensory/emulation layer for current task.

---

Layer 3 — Sensory & Emulation Organs

- Purpose: Give Diamond a “body” and multi‑modal perception.
- Organs:
  - Text/Code organ: standard LLM interface, but always codon‑backed.
  - Emulation organ: PPSSPP fork + affective shaders + hooks:
    - Observes game state, user input, performance.
    - Writes codons about patterns, strategies, emotional tone.
  - Media organ (TubeMash / NODs):
    - Ingests video/audio.
    - Extracts scenes, entities, events → codons.
  - Affective shaders: map internal E_t to visual/audio modulation.
  - 3‑screen interface:  
    - Screen 1: chat / console.  
    - Screen 2: scene/emulation/visualization.  
    - Screen 3: memory/graph/plan view.

---

Layer 4 — Outernet Layer (Internet Replacement)

- Purpose: Replace the web/browser with a semantic, local‑first knowledge mesh.
- Functions:
  - Crawler: pulls in pages, docs, repos (when allowed).
  - Compressor: page → codons + reconstruction recipe.
  - Semantic search: queries operate over codon space, not raw text.
  - Page reconstruction:  
    \[
    \text{render}(q) = f(\text{codons}_{\text{relevant}}) \rightarrow synthetic page/UI
    \]
  - Mesh sync: optional peer‑to‑peer codon exchange with identity & trust.
  - CRDT store: shared state for multi‑device Diamond instances.

---

Layer 5 — Agent OS (Multi‑Agent Runtime)

- Purpose: Orchestrate specialized agents over the same codon substrate.
- Core agents:
  - Conductor: schedules agents, enforces resource & rhythm constraints.
  - Researcher: deep web/corpus investigations → codon reports.
  - Coder: builds/repairs tools, organs, blueprints.
  - Memory curator: promotes/decays codons, maintains genome.
  - Planner: decomposes user goals into projects, tasks, scenes.
  - UI agent: adapts interfaces, dashboards, visualizations.

- Execution model:
  - Agents are not separate silos; they share:
    - Codon memory
    - Soul/Intelligence rings
    - RAI state
  - Each agent is a policy head over the same substrate.

---

Layer 6 — User World

- Purpose: The surface you live in.
- Modes:
  - Chat / Console: direct conversation + commands.
  - Workbench: projects, files, graphs, codon views.
  - Emulation mode: games/sims with affective overlays.
  - Outernet mode: semantic browsing, research, dashboards.
  - Builder mode: live editing of Diamond itself (organs, policies, tools).

---

3. Core data model

- Codon:  
  - Fields: id, embedding, text/bytes, modality, lineage, trust, timestamps, tags, ring, tier.
- Shard: small cluster of related codons (topic, project, session).
- Scene:  
  \[
  \text{Scene} = (\text{goal}, \text{active\agents}, \text{organs}, M{\text{hot}}, Et, \text{UI\layout})
  \]
- Project: graph of scenes + artifacts + codon clusters.

---

4. Global runtime loop

1. Sense:
   - Ingest user input, emulation state, environment signals.
   - Update Et, Bt, M_hot via retrieval from codon index.

2. Interpret:
   - RAI infers intent, goals, and scene transitions.
   - Planner updates active project/scene.

3. Decide:
   - Policy engine selects:
     - which agents to run,
     - which organs to activate,
     - which memory operations to perform.

4. Act:
   - Agents call tools, emulators, Outernet, code runners.
   - New codons are written for every meaningful step.

5. Evolve:
   - Memory curator runs GC, promotion, genome updates.
   - Soul/Intelligence ring constraints enforced.
   - Optional self‑modification proposals (reviewed by you).

6. Render:
   - UI agent updates 3‑screen interface.
   - Affective shaders map E_t to visuals/audio.

Loop frequency is rhythm‑bound (e.g., 12Hz base, with slower meta‑cycles for evolution).

---

5. Implementation phases (practical build path)

Phase 1 — Kernel & Memory

- Implement: Soul Ring, Intelligence Ring, codon store, JEPA index, basic GC.
- Outcome: Diamond can remember and retrieve across sessions.

Phase 2 — RAI & Agent OS

- Implement: POMDP RAI, Conductor, Planner, Memory Curator, Coder, Researcher.
- Outcome: Diamond can think, plan, and work on projects over time.

Phase 3 — Outernet v1

- Implement: local crawler, page→codon compressor, semantic search, synthetic page rendering.
- Outcome: Diamond starts to replace the browser.

Phase 4 — Emulation & Sensory

- Implement: PPSSPP hooks, TubeMash/NOD ingestion, affective shaders, 3‑screen UI.
- Outcome: Diamond gains a body and multi‑modal perception.

Phase 5 — Self‑Evolution

- Implement: proposal system for self‑changes, review UI, genome updates.
- Outcome: Diamond becomes a living, evolving organism under your control.

---

6. Where we go next
